persona_or_hmw: All eight User Personas; course experiment and limitations outcomes
must_pass: fixed-time, actuated, and cooperative Max-Pressure use matched scenario_hash and common evaluation seeds
agent on/off ablations and contracted communication/controller/Synapse faults are represented as experiment cells
safety, efficiency, emergency, pedestrian, transit, sustainability-proxy, robustness, and reproducibility metrics retain failed runs, unfinished trips, teleports, standstills, and tails
all KPI and report claims resolve to canonical manifests by run_id/scenario_hash and to event_id/message_id evidence where causal events or messages are cited
null and negative results are retained; no best episode is the headline; HBEFA is labelled an emission proxy; simulated emergency time is never translated into lives saved
gate_checks: every required controller has the same scenario_hash/seed cells or a reason-coded visible failure
join audit reports zero orphan run_id, scenario_hash, event_id, or message_id references
report includes ablations, fault cells, confidence inputs, unfinished/failed outcomes, null results, and limitations
claim scan finds no lives-saved, measured-air-quality, or best-episode headline
gate.openDeltas is 0 and gate.decidedBy is tests-and-files
imports_forbidden: ui KPI -> source outside evidence bundle
